title: Spices Board Recruitment 2026 – Trainee (Development) Posts
shortInfo: Spices Board has announced notification for Trainee (Development) posts. Required qualification: B.Sc in Agri/Horti/Forestry/Bot/Micro/Biotech. Last date to apply: 19-10-26.
howToApply: Before appearing for the written test, candidates must ensure that the application is submitted online. Last date for submitting online application is 19.10.2026.
Eligible candidates shall submit the application online at http://spicesboard.in/recruitment/.
Candidates reporting after the specified time or failing to submit their application online will not be permitted to participate in the test.
Candidates are required to report at the venue at least 30 minutes prior to the scheduled time for certificate verification.
Candidates must bring all original documents and certificates, along with one set of self-attested copies each, pertaining to identity, age, and educational qualifications for verification purpose.
Those who have not received their final degree certificate yet need not appear for the test.
Before applying, candidates should ensure that they fulfill the eligibility criteria for the training as mentioned in the notification.
Those who have undergone training in any offices of Spices Board earlier need not apply again regardless of whether they have completed their training or not.
Candidates once selected will be required to undergo training in any of the offices of Spices Board under the mentioned region/regional office.
No TA/DA will be given to candidates who attend the Written Test.
Candidates are advised to check the Board’s website www.indianspices.com for updates and not to rely on information from third-party websites.
Candidates shall obtain the original Degree certificate within two years from the date of issue of Provisional Degree certificate.

howToApply: Visit the MRPL website at https://www.mrpl.co.in/careers and click on ‘Advt. No. MRPL/PFTE/2026/02: Engagement of Personnel on Fixed Term Employment’.
Click on ‘Click here to register online’ to generate Login ID and Password.
Sign in using the generated Login ID and Password and fill in the online application form with correct details including educational qualifications, caste, and other required information.
Upload scanned copies of required documents: recent passport size photograph, signature, educational credentials, work experience documents, caste/PwBD/EWS certificate as applicable.
Upon submission, the system will generate an Application ID sent via email/SMS.

General, OBC(NCL) and EWS candidates: Click ‘Pay Now’, select payment category as ‘Advt. No. MRPL/PFTE/2026/02’, and pay application fee of ₹118/- online. Save and upload the payment confirmation receipt. Then click ‘Already Paid’, sign in, submit SBI eCollect Reference Number, Payment Bank Name and Payment Date, upload receipt, and click ‘Next’. Then upload all required documents and click ‘Submit’.
SC/ST/PwBD/ESM candidates: Directly upload scanned copies of photograph, signature, educational credentials, work experience documents and other required documents, then click ‘Submit’.
Save the PDF of the submitted online application form for future reference. Do not send the printout to MRPL unless specifically asked.
